parameters.name: DeviceName
parameters.description:
The device name of the device you want to query.

><notice>
If you specify this parameter, you must also specify ProductKey.
></notice>

parameters.name: FunctionBlockId
parameters.description:
The identifier of the custom module in the Thing Specification Language model. The identifier is unique within the product.

If you do not specify this parameter, the data of the default module is queried.

parameters.name: IotId
parameters.description:
The device ID or IoT twin node ID of the device whose properties you want to query:

- Call the [QueryDeviceInfo](~~QueryDeviceInfo~~) operation to query the **IotId** of a specified device.
- In the IoT Platform console, on the **Twin Entity Graph** page, click a twin node to view the **Node ID**.


> **IotId** is a globally unique identifier for a device and has a one-to-one mapping with the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**. If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **ProductKey** or **DeviceName**. If you specify **IotId** together with the **ProductKey** and **DeviceName** combination, **IotId** takes precedence.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. On the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console, you can view the **ID** of the current instance.


> - If this **ID** value is available, you must specify it. Otherwise, the call fails.
>  - If the **Overview** page or **ID** value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description:
The ProductKey of the product to which the device you want to query belongs.

><notice>
If you specify this parameter, you must also specify DeviceName.
></notice>
